This atom's ext dep 'EXT:ECOSYSTEM-TOOLING:registry.json listings record signer identity' restated its OWN second done-when clause as a precondition: the dep text and the clause were word-for-word the same deliverable. It resolved to ET-3, which is done and whose done_when covers the registry schema, validation script, listing CI, CONTRIBUTING and delisting policy but says nothing about signer identity — and app-registry.schema.json carries zero signer/signature/publisher/identity keys. So the gate was void in fact while the real live blocker was not modelled at all: SH-11's own title says it 'gates DC-1/DCU-3/SH-4', yet SH-11 was absent from these deps. Both are fixed here. The credential-free half is split out as SH-12 (a listing records its signer with no secret required) and is startable now; what remains on SH-4 is the CI-signing clause, which genuinely cannot clear until the owner supplies the Apple Developer secrets and the production minisign key via SH-11. |
